The new era of
Defence Garden

For twenty years we have shaped land in Western Uttar Pradesh into gated, green, clearly-titled colonies. Now we are carrying the same principles upward — into residential towers for India's growing cities.

Our story

Our story began in Meerut with a quiet conviction — that land, carefully shaped, becomes a legacy.

What started as a single layout in Meerut became a philosophy — plan with patience, build infrastructure first, leave the ground better than we found it. Today that philosophy shapes townships across Meerut, Budhana, and Shamli.

What guides us

Principles we carry
from land to towers

  1. 01

    Trust & Transparency

    Legal clarity, ethical delivery, and open communication behind every plot we hand over.

  2. 02

    Future-Ready Planning

    Wide roads, clear zoning, and practical amenities that create value today and confidence tomorrow.

  3. 03

    Sustainable Living

    Neighborhoods designed around trees, airflow, and open greens — so each community breathes naturally.

  4. 04

    Security by Design

    Gated communities with 24/7 security, boundary walls and planned, well-lit streets.
